I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this veterinary clinic.

I came to this clinic on the recommendation of my Mini Pinscher puppy's breeders, who informed me that all of her veterinary care was provided here. For this reason, I fully trusted the "professionals" at this clinic.

However, several situations arose during the course of treatment that left me very worried.

I was told that my puppy could already go for walks outside, even though she hadn't yet completed her vaccination schedule (she was missing the rabies vaccine). Later, after consulting another veterinarian, I was informed that this was not advisable, especially due to the risks of exposure to diseases before adequate protection.

Subsequently, my puppy began to have gastrointestinal problems. I took her to the clinic and asked if this was normal. I was given a powder to mix with her food for four days and told that if she didn't improve, they would proceed directly to antibiotics. At no point was any analysis or examination suggested to try to understand the origin of the problem!!!

I was truly shocked by this approach. Later, when consulting another veterinarian, it was explained to me that before starting antibiotic treatment, a proper assessment of the situation should be carried out and, when necessary, tests should be performed to identify the cause of the problem.

What shocked me most was the fact that they were prepared to administer a vaccine to my puppy when she was still experiencing gastrointestinal problems. At the same time, they were ready to proceed with antibiotics without any analysis having been done to understand what was really happening. The veterinarian who currently treats my puppy explained that, as a general rule, an animal should be healthy before receiving vaccines, except in very specific situations that have been properly evaluated.

Furthermore, when my puppy presented these problems, I sent a message to Dr. Sara via WhatsApp, accompanied by photographs to show the situation. I received no response. I ended up having to call to get some guidance. For me, this is not normal and does not correspond to the level of attention and follow-up I expect from a veterinary clinic.

I would also like to emphasize that we are talking about a Miniature Pinscher puppy that is only three months old. This is an extremely young animal, still growing and developing, which makes careful, attentive, and rigorous veterinary monitoring even more important.

Fortunately, I found a veterinarian who is truly a professional I fully trust. Thanks to this, I feel that my puppy is now receiving the proper care and improving.

As a pet owner, I am not a veterinary professional and I rely on the guidance of specialists. Precisely for this reason, I consider it essential to be able to trust the recommendations I receive. Unfortunately, after this experience, I have completely lost that trust in this clinic.

I will not use their services again and, personally, I would not recommend them to anyone seeking quality veterinary care for their animals.

My dog ​​is 5 months old and weighs 1.5 kg… he’s not even big enough for anything. Like all dogs, he gets scared and might try to bite if the person isn’t careful enough to pick him up or give him the vaccine… the veterinarian Sara is afraid of him, afraid the poor thing will bite her… her assistant Zé already said that I should hit my dog ​​to train him. If you don’t have the tact to treat an animal and you have the audacity to say such nonsense, you’re in the wrong profession.

Animals like to be greeted with a party, to be treated well, my dog ​​is very loving with people who know how to handle animals, telling someone to hit an animal of that size is cowardly, it’s one of the most absurd things I’ve ever heard from a professional. I will never take him there again, zero trust. Learn to enjoy what you do and treat animals well to excel at what you do.
Affordable prices, welcoming space, good professionals... I recommend it.
Excellent so far, 5 stars, they are super friendly and attentive.
